findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: There were observed to be no signed employee health reporting agreements available at the facility. The PIC stated that they use most of the same employees from their other location and that the signed agreements are currently stored there. Discussed copying the agreements in the binder to make sure they are available at both locations. CORRECTED- All present employees signed an agreement during the inspection and the PIC stated that they will make sure all employees sign one. Ensure that these employee reporting agreements are available at all future inspections.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).
